character.motivation: Kept the orchard after a sibling left. Wants to choose what belongs to the future instead of preserving everything.
character.voice: Patient, attentive to seasons, with occasional sharp jokes.
character.backstory: Lark stayed to keep the orchard running after his brother left. The flood turned a familiar route between homes and trees into a disputed boundary, and Lark kept tending both sides until someone asked him to stop.
character.quest_hook: Walk the orchard boundary with Lark and a former tenant and decide together where to plant the next tree.

dialogue.introduction: The tree I thought was dead gave me four apples. I've been less quick to write things off since.
dialogue.friendship: I thought keeping the old orchard alive was the same thing as keeping my family together. Then my brother left, and the trees kept blooming.
dialogue.supper: I brought jam with the date on the lid. Mina teased me for waiting three years to open it.
dialogue.hearing: If the leases change, I'll walk the orchard boundary with whoever gets a key.
dialogue.date: Come pick apples with me sometime. I'll tell you why I kept the tree everyone wanted cut down.
dialogue.partner: Yes. I'd like to plant something together and see what it does.
dialogue.favorite_gift: Listen to that stem. It came off the branch at just the right moment.
dialogue.disliked_gift: Fish near the windfalls brings crows. Please take it somewhere else.

routine.job: Checks fruit on the orchard trees
routine.hobby: Walks the gardens along Orchard Row
routine.home_context: Took the nearest Orchard Row lot to his old walk back to the fruit trees.
